name: Kimchi premium RSI combo (Bithumb BTCKRW vs Bitstamp BTCUSD)
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
indicators: RSI(4) of close, RSI(12) of inverse kimchi premium, FX-converted BTCUSD
entry_long: ikp = (BTCUSD converted to KRW / BTCKRW - 1)*100 ("inverse kimchi premium"). tot_rsi = average of RSI(4) of price and RSI(12) of ikp. Go long when tot_rsi crosses above 63.
exit: Stop-and-reverse: no separate exit; reverse to short on cross under 28.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: Bull level 63 / bear level 28 inputs; option to use price RSI only
implementation_notes: Directional signal from the premium series, not true arbitrage. FX conversion symbol is a script input.
